g.text: Inventories and execution retain their own accounts
Same saved V6 episode. Work records do not diagnose, repair, create evidence or close a risk issue.
Water uses one zero-K sensible cp*T reference in internal storage, leak, floor mixing and drainage; carried energy is separate from heat-transfer power.
Original execution b135ecffb5fe; pure R134a EOS surrogate restricted to 0.1..3 MPa two-phase equilibrium. Actual site coolant remains unknown.
